description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there’s no telling what you could accomplish.

Contacts plays an essential role in connecting people all over the world. The frameworks built by the Contacts team drive the people experiences across all Apple platforms. They power not just the Contacts app, but FaceTime, Phone, Messages, Mail, Calendar, and many more.

We're looking for a passionate software engineer to help us build the foundations of Apple's communication experiences. Our mission: build delightful and magical experiences to help people connect easier than ever before. Help us empower our users to represent themselves as their beautiful and authentic selves across the entire Apple ecosystem, including iPhone, iPad, and Mac.


Description
You'll be joining a passionate team of engineers dedicated to creating reliable, innovative communications technologies that impact millions of users worldwide. We fulfill our duty by caring deeply, living on our software, developing defensible opinions on what to keep/what to change, and having empathy for the countless users in the world who rely on us every day. If you're excited about building powerful products that change customers' lives while growing your skills and leading important initiatives, we want to hear from you.

Minimum qualifications
You possess strong software development and design skills.
You have strong object-oriented programming skills in Swift or Objective-C.
You have strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
You are self-directed and can solve problems independently.


Preferred qualifications
You have a strong understanding of building frameworks and daemons for an operating system.
You have created and refined APIs intended for other teams and developers to adopt.
You have a proven track record of building apps with UIKit, AppKit, and/or SwiftUI.
You have a genuine passion for consumer products.
